guides.title: Fibromyalgia
guides.description: Low-dose naltrexone in fibromyalgia: the pain-processing rationale and the results of a larger placebo-controlled trial.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Fibromyalgia causes widespread pain and tenderness, often with fatigue, unrefreshing sleep and difficulty thinking clearly. Research points to altered pain processing rather than a single damaged joint or muscle. Low-dose naltrexone has been studied as a way to change central pain modulation.

sentences.text: Fibromyalgia causes widespread pain and tenderness, often with fatigue, unrefreshing sleep and difficulty thinking clearly. Research points to altered pain processing rather than a single damaged joint or muscle.
Low-dose naltrexone has been studied as a way to change central pain modulation.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: In a 2024 trial of 99 women, naltrexone did not produce superior pain relief over placebo after 12 weeks. The between-group pain difference was −0.34 points on an 11-point scale, with a 95% confidence interval from −0.95 to 0.27. The exploratory report did not find an association between changes in conditioned pain modulation and improvement in clinical pain. Part of the group difference reflected worsening in the placebo group. Confidence that this isolated laboratory result demonstrates meaningful symptom benefit is Low: the authors considered it potentially spurious, and several exploratory outcomes were tested without a dedicated sample-size calculation.

The exploratory report did not find an association between changes in conditioned pain modulation and improvement in clinical pain. Part of the group difference reflected worsening in the placebo group. Confidence that this isolated laboratory result demonstrates meaningful symptom benefit is Low: the authors considered it potentially spurious, and several exploratory outcomes were tested without a dedicated sample-size calculation.

questions.question: Does the trial rule out every possible benefit?
questions.answer: It did not demonstrate the primary pain benefit. Exploratory findings concerning memory or pain modulation address different outcomes and need confirmation rather than being substituted for the pain result.

sentences.text: It did not demonstrate the primary pain benefit. Exploratory findings concerning memory or pain modulation address different outcomes and need confirmation rather than being substituted for the pain result.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Adverse events were reported by 84% of naltrexone recipients and 86% of placebo recipients in the 2024 trial. Four naltrexone recipients and three placebo recipients stopped because of adverse events.

sentences.text: Adverse events were reported by 84% of naltrexone recipients and 86% of placebo recipients in the 2024 trial. Four naltrexone recipients and three placebo recipients stopped because of adverse events.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: Fibromyalgia care commonly combines movement-based approaches, psychological or behavioral treatment and medicines. The naltrexone trial compared the drug with placebo; it did not establish superiority to that broader approach or to another active medicine.

sentences.text: Fibromyalgia care commonly combines movement-based approaches, psychological or behavioral treatment and medicines. The naltrexone trial compared the drug with placebo; it did not establish superiority to that broader approach or to another active medicine.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: The pain trial was randomized and double-blind. Its estimate allows both a modest pain benefit and no benefit, but does not support the proposed average superiority over placebo. A later report examined exploratory pain-processing and muscle-endurance outcomes from the same FINAL trial. It is not an independent second treatment trial. The complete-case analysis included 45 naltrexone and 47 placebo participants. Only conditioned pain modulation differed significantly among the five exploratory outcomes: the between-group change was 2.0 kPa, with a 95% confidence interval of 0.4 to 3.7 kPa. That laboratory finding should be read alongside the trial's clinical pain result, rather than substituted for it.

sections.paragraph: The naltrexone profile and ME/CFS page address other proposed uses, but the fibromyalgia pain trial remains a separate clinical test.

faqs.question: Does fibromyalgia affect more than pain?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sleep problems, fatigue and cognitive symptoms are common. A pain trial does not automatically answer whether a treatment helps these other difficulties.

sentences.text: Yes. Sleep problems, fatigue and cognitive symptoms are common. A pain trial does not automatically answer whether a treatment helps these other difficulties.

faqs.question: Does a change in pain inhibition show that naltrexone treats fibromyalgia?
faqs.answer: Not by itself. Conditioned pain modulation tests how one painful stimulus changes the response to another. In this secondary analysis, its change did not track clinical pain improvement, and the investigators found no clear between-group differences in the other tested pain-tolerance or muscle-endurance outcomes. A proposed pain-processing mechanism therefore remains separate from evidence that patients feel or function better.

guides.title: Chronic myeloid leukemia
guides.description: Pioglitazone research aimed at deeper molecular responses in chronic myeloid leukemia.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Chronic myeloid leukemia involves abnormal myeloid blood cells. Pioglitazone has been studied alongside imatinib to target persistent leukemia cells after an initial molecular response.

sentences.text: Chronic myeloid leukemia involves abnormal myeloid blood cells. Pioglitazone has been studied alongside imatinib to target persistent leukemia cells after an initial molecular response.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: The ACTIM study reported deep molecular responses after adding pioglitazone to imatinib. Its single-arm design cannot establish how many responses were caused by pioglitazone rather than continued imatinib treatment. ACTIM enrolled people whose CML was already responding to long-term imatinib, but had not reached the study's deeper molecular-response target. It therefore examined an add-on strategy for residual disease, rather than pioglitazone as a replacement for a leukemia medicine. Twenty-four patients were evaluable. The estimated cumulative incidence of reaching MR4.5 by 12 months was 56%, with a 95% confidence interval of 37% to 76%.

sentences.text: The ACTIM study reported deep molecular responses after adding pioglitazone to imatinib. Its single-arm design cannot establish how many responses were caused by pioglitazone rather than continued imatinib treatment.

The estimated cumulative incidence of reaching MR4.5 by 12 months was 56%, with a 95% confidence interval of 37% to 76%.

questions.question: Was pioglitazone tested instead of imatinib?
questions.answer: No. Participants continued imatinib, and the question was whether adding pioglitazone could deepen an existing molecular response.

sentences.text: No. Participants continued imatinib, and the question was whether adding pioglitazone could deepen an existing molecular response.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Edema led one ACTIM participant to stop pioglitazone. Fluid retention is especially relevant when adding this medicine to an ongoing cancer regimen. The main report also describes weight gain and a reduction in hemoglobin during treatment. Pioglitazone exposure varied because several participants stopped early after a regulatory concern about bladder cancer; the study was too small to resolve uncommon or delayed harms. These observations qualify the interpretation of tolerability and do not establish the safety of adding pioglitazone to every CML regimen.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: ACTIM did not include a randomized imatinib-only group. Historical response rates offer context but cannot provide an equally reliable treatment comparison.

sentences.text: ACTIM did not include a randomized imatinib-only group. Historical response rates offer context but cannot provide an equally reliable treatment comparison.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: ACTIM used a molecular endpoint, MR4.5, indicating very low BCR::ABL1 transcript levels. The absence of concurrent randomization limits attribution of deeper response. Confidence that pioglitazone itself improves CML outcomes is Low. A separate imatinib-only cohort provided a nonrandomized comparison, so differences between patients or continued imatinib treatment could help explain the apparent response. MR4.5 describes a very low level of leukemia-associated RNA; it is not the same as a demonstrated survival advantage, cure or evidence that stopping imatinib is safe. The authors called for confirmation in a randomized trial.

sections.paragraph: The pioglitazone profile describes PPARγ activation, the mechanism proposed to complement imatinib.

sentences.text: The pioglitazone profile describes PPARγ activation, the mechanism proposed to complement imatinib.

faqs.question: What is measured in a CML molecular response?
faqs.answer: The test measures BCR::ABL1 transcripts. MR4.5 indicates a very deep reduction, and is different from an ordinary blood count becoming normal.

sentences.text: The test measures BCR::ABL1 transcripts. MR4.5 indicates a very deep reduction, and is different from an ordinary blood count becoming normal.

faqs.question: Did ACTIM prove that the proposed stem-cell mechanism caused the response?
faqs.answer: No. The investigators measured changes in STAT5 RNA and colony formation in bone-marrow cell samples, but those measurements do not prove that elimination of leukemia stem cells caused the molecular responses. The mechanism remains a rationale for investigation. Its relationship to a patient-important treatment benefit has Low clinical confidence in this single-arm study.

guides.title: Fluvoxamine
guides.description: An OCD medicine investigated for inflammatory effects in acute COVID-19 and persistent fatigue.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Fluvoxamine is an SSRI used for OCD. In acute COVID-19, a later randomized trial did not show faster sustained recovery.

sentences.text: Fluvoxamine is an SSRI used for OCD.
In acute COVID-19, a later randomized trial did not show faster sustained recovery.

sections.label: Benefits
sections.paragraph: The ACTIV-6 higher-dose trial did not demonstrate faster recovery from acute COVID-19. The original REVIVE Long COVID fatigue report carries a retraction-and-republication notice, so its original estimate cannot support a benefit claim. For the studied acute outpatient illness, confidence in the finding of no faster sustained recovery is Moderate. ACTIV-6 defined recovery as three consecutive days without COVID-19 symptoms. The median time was 10 days in both groups; the recovery hazard ratio was 0.99, with a 95% credible interval of 0.89 to 1.09. This result concerns that symptom endpoint and population, rather than every possible use or stage of infection.

questions.question: Does it shorten acute COVID-19?
questions.answer: In ACTIV-6, fluvoxamine did not significantly shorten the time to sustained recovery compared with placebo.

sentences.text: In ACTIV-6, fluvoxamine did not significantly shorten the time to sustained recovery compared with placebo.

questions.question: Does it relieve Long COVID fatigue?
questions.answer: The original REVIVE fatigue results were retracted for republication; the original result should not be presented as an established treatment effect.

sentences.text: The original REVIVE fatigue results were retracted for republication; the original result should not be presented as an established treatment effect.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Nausea, sleep disturbance and sexual dysfunction are recognized adverse effects; serious risks include serotonin syndrome, bleeding and increased suicidal thinking in younger patients. Serious adverse events were uncommon in ACTIV-6, so the trial offers limited precision about rare harms. The absence of an observed excess in that selected outpatient sample does not establish that fluvoxamine is suitable for everyone. The study excluded several groups, including people using certain antidepressants and those with known contraindications; trial tolerability does not remove the separate prescribing restrictions.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: Contraindicated combinations include MAO inhibitors, tizanidine, thioridazine, pimozide and alosetron.

sentences.text: Contraindicated combinations include MAO inhibitors, tizanidine, thioridazine, pimozide and alosetron.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Fluvoxamine inhibits several liver drug-metabolizing enzymes, increasing exposure to medicines including clozapine and warfarin; NSAIDs and other serotonergic drugs add bleeding or serotonin risks.

sentences.text: Fluvoxamine inhibits several liver drug-metabolizing enzymes, increasing exposure to medicines including clozapine and warfarin; NSAIDs and other serotonergic drugs add bleeding or serotonin risks.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: ACTIV-6 studied 50 mg twice daily on day 1, followed by 100 mg twice daily for 12 additional days; that experimental course did not improve sustained recovery.

sentences.text: ACTIV-6 studied 50 mg twice daily on day 1, followed by 100 mg twice daily for 12 additional days; that experimental course did not improve sustained recovery.

sections.label: Results
sections.paragraph: The measured endpoint in ACTIV-6 was sustained recovery from the acute infection, not treatment of established Long COVID.

sentences.text: The measured endpoint in ACTIV-6 was sustained recovery from the acute infection, not treatment of established Long COVID.

sections.label: Quality
sections.paragraph: The label describes oral tablets in 25, 50 and 100 mg strengths.

sentences.text: The label describes oral tablets in 25, 50 and 100 mg strengths.

sections.label: Status
sections.paragraph: The US tablet indication is OCD; COVID-19 and Long COVID are investigated uses outside that indication.

sentences.text: The US tablet indication is OCD; COVID-19 and Long COVID are investigated uses outside that indication.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: The measured endpoint in ACTIV-6 was sustained recovery from the acute infection, not treatment of established Long COVID. The higher-dose study used randomized, double-blind allocation to fluvoxamine or a matched placebo. Its statistical plan treated secondary outcomes, including health-care use, as exploratory and did not select a secondary decision threshold. The health-care-use estimate was uncertain and compatible with no effect. It cannot be substituted for the unsuccessful primary recovery result, and the trial was not a comparison with another active COVID-19 medicine.

sections.paragraph: Research connections include Long COVID and Acute COVID-19.

faqs.question: What is its established use?
faqs.answer: Fluvoxamine blocks serotonin reuptake, increasing serotonin signaling; its labeled use is obsessive-compulsive disorder.

guides.title: Sildenafil
guides.description: A PDE5 inhibitor with distinct pancreatic combination experiments and potentially contrary glioblastoma biology.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Sildenafil is established for erectile dysfunction and pulmonary arterial hypertension. Its cancer investigations concern cell signaling and treatment combinations.

sentences.text: Sildenafil is established for erectile dysfunction and pulmonary arterial hypertension. Its cancer investigations concern cell signaling and treatment combinations.

sections.label: Benefits
sections.paragraph: Pancreatic cell experiments found increased chemotherapy killing with PDE5 inhibitors. Glioblastoma experiments provide a counterpoint: sildenafil increased migration in one cell model.

sentences.text: Pancreatic cell experiments found increased chemotherapy killing with PDE5 inhibitors. Glioblastoma experiments provide a counterpoint: sildenafil increased migration in one cell model.

questions.question: Did the pancreatic experiments demonstrate longer patient survival?
questions.answer: They measured cancer-cell killing and signaling under experimental drug combinations.

sentences.text: They measured cancer-cell killing and signaling under experimental drug combinations.

questions.question: Why is the glioblastoma result important?
questions.answer: The direction of the migration effect was unfavorable, showing that PDE5 blockade can have different consequences in different tumor contexts.

sentences.text: The direction of the migration effect was unfavorable, showing that PDE5 blockade can have different consequences in different tumor contexts.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Common effects include headache, flushing, and dyspepsia. Hypotension, sudden hearing loss, and serious visual symptoms are important labeled concerns. The brief experiment enrolled healthy volunteers who were free of medication. It cannot establish safety in patients receiving chemotherapy, multiple blood-pressure medicines or long-term treatment. Its physiological observations therefore add no general clearance for those combinations and do not replace the distinct contraindications and interaction information in the prescribing labels.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: Concurrent organic nitrates or riociguat are contraindicated because of excessive blood-pressure lowering.

sentences.text: Concurrent organic nitrates or riociguat are contraindicated because of excessive blood-pressure lowering.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: CYP3A inhibitors can increase sildenafil exposure; other blood-pressure-lowering drugs can increase hypotension.

sentences.text: CYP3A inhibitors can increase sildenafil exposure; other blood-pressure-lowering drugs can increase hypotension.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: The pancreatic experiments used drug combinations in cell models. The PAH and erectile-dysfunction schedules are separate clinical regimens, not cancer dosing schedules. The hypoxia experiment used an initial 50 mg oral dose during normal oxygen conditions and a second 50 mg dose during the hypoxia visit, with timed measurements after administration. This describes that short laboratory protocol only. It supplies neither a cancer-treatment schedule nor evidence that repeating the protocol outside the experiment is beneficial or safe.

sections.label: Results
sections.paragraph: The glioblastoma cohort associated PDE5 expression with outcome, while cell experiments tested migration directly. The observational association is not a trial of sildenafil treatment.

sentences.text: The glioblastoma cohort associated PDE5 expression with outcome, while cell experiments tested migration directly. The observational association is not a trial of sildenafil treatment.

sections.label: Quality
sections.paragraph: Sildenafil products for erectile dysfunction and pulmonary hypertension use different strengths and schedules; the active ingredient alone does not define an equivalent regimen.

sentences.text: Sildenafil products for erectile dysfunction and pulmonary hypertension use different strengths and schedules; the active ingredient alone does not define an equivalent regimen.

sections.label: Status
sections.paragraph: US sildenafil products have erectile-dysfunction or pulmonary-hypertension indications. The cancer investigations described here are experimental.

sentences.text: US sildenafil products have erectile-dysfunction or pulmonary-hypertension indications. The cancer investigations described here are experimental.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: Pancreatic support comes from experimental combination treatment. The glioblastoma report combines tumor-expression associations with mechanistic cell work, including an opposing signal. A separate randomized crossover experiment studied cerebral circulation during acute laboratory hypoxia in 12 healthy men. It found changes in selected vascular and redox measures, rather than a demonstrated improvement in cancer or neurological disease. Confidence that these physiological findings predict benefit in another clinical condition is Low: the population, short exposure and measured endpoints do not answer those treatment questions.

sections.paragraph: Pancreatic cancer focuses on sensitization to chemotherapy; glioblastoma raises a separate question about PDE5, migration, and aggressiveness.

sentences.text: Pancreatic cancer focuses on sensitization to chemotherapy; glioblastoma raises a separate question about PDE5, migration, and aggressiveness.

sections.label: Research
sections.paragraph: The useful question is which combination and tumor context produces a favorable effect, rather than treating PDE5 inhibition as uniformly antitumor.

faqs.question: Can sildenafil be combined with nitrate medicines?
faqs.answer: The product labeling contraindicates the combination because blood pressure can fall dangerously.

sentences.text: The product labeling contraindicates the combination because blood pressure can fall dangerously.

faqs.question: Did the hypoxia study show that sildenafil increased nitric oxide or brain oxygen delivery?
faqs.answer: Not as a general explanation. The investigators reported selected cerebrovascular changes without an increase in measured vascular nitric oxide bioavailability. Changes in blood-flow regulation, redox markers and oxygen-related measures are distinct outcomes. The experiment does not demonstrate that sildenafil improves oxygen delivery in tumors or produces an anticancer effect.
